name: Enterprise Organizational Unit and Mandate
constraints: Organizational-unit identity is stable across rename, mandate change and reparenting.
Merge, split and disband append explicit lineage through a reorganization act.
Every structural placement declares child, parent, axis, scenario, validity and evidence.
An unqualified parent field is a read projection and never a second write authority.
Tree-like axes permit at most one parent per child, axis, scenario and instant.
Acyclicity is evaluated independently for each axis, scenario and interval.
Approved-future and hypothetical placements remain outside asserted-current reads until adoption.
Management placement never determines employer or legal-entity identity.
Cross-functional teams and communities use affiliation and cannot be forced into administrative containment.
Unit mandate has its own governing instrument, validity and evidence independent of placement.
holds: Scenario-aware query and hypothetical-branch semantics are absent from the base.
Unit/site and finance-axis boundaries remain unresolved.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit are pending.
